a.xlink:title: Default name of the solver executable, resolved using the system path.

Command-line arguments given the merged options. An argument is an atom or a list of atoms to be concatenated where ``$input`` is the path of the LP file and ``$solution`` the path of a file that the solver can write its solution to.

Decodes the solver standard output and solution file contents into a status (``optimal``, ``feasible``, ``infeasible``, ``unbounded``, ``infeasible_or_unbounded``, ``time_limit``, ``iteration_limit``, ``node_limit``, or ``numerical_error``), an objective value (or ``none``), solution data represented as ``solution(Pairs)`` when a solution section was parsed or ``none`` otherwise, and the status text reported by the solver. The pairs use the one-based variable index; absent variables in a parsed solution have value zero.
Assembles a validated result from already decoded solver data.
Splits character codes into lines (removing carriage returns).
Splits a line into blank-separated words.
Parses a decimal number (optional sign, fraction, and exponent). Fails if the codes are not a number.
True if some line contains the given text.
Finds the first line starting with the given prefix and returns the rest of the line without leading blanks.
Converts character codes to an atom with the blanks normalized to single spaces and without leading and trailing blanks.
Converts a number to an atom.
Returns the first word of a list of words that is a number.
